Overview of Extremadura Region (Extremadura)

Extremadura Region (Extremadura) is located in the Extremadura region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Badajoz. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Casco Histórico & Plaza Mayor, Cathedral & Alcázar, Traditional Mercado Central, Evening Paseo & tapas quarter.

RegionExtremadura
Capital cityBadajoz
Cities & municipalities10
Primary transport hubBadajoz Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Extremadura Region

Connected via Renfe AVE / Avlo / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed rail and ALSA intercity coaches. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Extremadura

When visiting cities across Extremadura, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Tapas & raciones
  • Jamón Ibérico de Bellota
  • Tortilla Española
  • Churros con chocolate
  • Regional DO wines

Best time to visit Extremadura

Best time to visit Extremadura: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.
